item.title: Delhi court orders probe into Ashish Sood’s defamation charge against AAP’s Parveen Kumar
item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 8: A Delhi court has directed the police to conduct an investigation into allegations made by Delhi minister Ashish Sood against AAP candidate Parveen Kumar of circulating false, misleading and defamatory information on social media during the 2025 Delhi Assembly elections. Judicial Magistrate First Class, Harjot Singh Aujla, who was hearing an application moved by the minister, said that the “aspects cannot be effectively examined without police investigation”. item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 8: Sun Pharma will maintain a disciplined approach when it comes to acquisitions in order to allow the business to grow organically while remaining attractive for shareholders, according to Chairman Dilip Shanghvi. item.title: Mcap of 8 of top 10 valued firms surges by whopping Rs 4.55 lakh cr; Reliance biggest winner
item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 8: The combined market valuation of eight of the top 10 valued firms jumped by a whopping Rs 4.55 lakh crore last week, with Reliance Industries emerging as the biggest winner, in line with a remarkable rally in equities. Last week, the BSE benchmark surged by 2,857.46 points or 3.53 per cent. item.title: Shree Cements eyes Q4FY26 volume rebound, plans aggressive RMC expansion
item.description: KOLKATA, Feb 8: Shree Cements expects a strong rebound in cement volumes in the fourth quarter of the current financial year, aided by a pick-up in infrastructure activity and higher government spending towards the fiscal year-end, the management said in a Q3 analyst concall. The company is targeting sales volumes of 9-9.5 million tonnes in the January-March quarter. item.title: IPO-bound PhonePe targets growth in payments, merchants, new platforms
item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 8: Walmart-backed PhonePe, which aims to float its initial public offering (IPO) in April, plans to deepen its presence in India’s digital payments market while expanding into financial services and new consumer platforms. In its draft papers, the company said digital payments will remain the core driver of growth, supported by investments to expand its user base, addressable market and platform scale. item.title: Mundra Port posts record auto exports, liquid cargo handling in January
item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 8: Adani Group’s Mundra Port in Gujarat has recorded a sharp increase in automobile exports and liquid cargo volumes in January 2026, posting multiple operational records that highlighted the growing role of large, integrated ports in supporting India’s trade and export flows. item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 8: After three consecutive months of heavy selling, foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) turned net buyers in the first week of February, infusing more than Rs 8,100 crore in Indian equities, aided by improving risk sentiment, along with a trade deal with the US.
